verified_facts.text: The resort has a 27-hole golf course designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr. within the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 27-hole Sintra golf course at Penha Longa Resort, designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr., delivers a championship test framed by the tranquility of the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park.

verified_facts.text: The spa, guided by Zen philosophy, occupies its own building within the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park.
